dataset_name: Intel RealSense D455 Multi-Session (recording_01 vs recording_02)

arm_c0_keep.description: Retain all observations in single static nodes without lifecycle split.

arm_c3_graph_mark_suspect.description: Retain observation history but flag suspect entities with 10x covariance inflation.

arm_c4_graph_temporary_exclude.description: Temporarily exclude suspect entities from active reference map during exploration.

arm_relocate_split.description: Split entity into prior and current nodes linked by relocation displacement edge.

arm_reactivate.description: Re-anchor confirmed static entity in Session 2 reference frame.
